propositions: The session-scoped `run_request_sites` fixture rebuilds parent maps and rescans all source trees per lookup, causing 9.54M ast.walk iterations across 46.95–49.02s CI setup instead of using cached parsed structure.

The `_verdict` helper recomputes caller/parent relationships for every parameter hop by iterating every `src/rebar/**/*.py` file and re-walking each cached tree, rather than querying a precomputed index.

An immutable per-process `_AstIndex` must be built once from cached parsed modules to index parents, enclosing functions, and call sites, reducing setup to <1s and eliminating repeated whole-corpus traversal.
All 24 existing ordered provenance tuples, four semantic verdicts, and behavioral contract coverage must remain unchanged after indexing refactoring.
A deterministic oracle must fail when whole-tree caller/parent rediscovery is reintroduced, confirming the index is the source of performance and correctness gain.
No production files, public APIs, or test skip/xfail/assertion removals are permitted; only private test-helper optimization within the single test module.
